```yaml
name: Conventional Commits

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  pr-title-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y git-core
      - name: Run PR title lint
        run: |
          npx conventionalcommitslint --from=HEAD~1 --to=HEAD

  release-please:
    needs: pr-title-lint
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run release-please
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: npx release-please --repo-owner=stillwater-sc --repo-name=universal --bump-minor-pr-labels="chore" --bump-patch-pr-labels="bug" --release-type=node --release-as-draft=false --snapshot=false --changelog-path=CHANGELOG.md --version-file=CMakeLists.txt:x-release-please-major/minor/patch

  docker-build:
    needs: release-please
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build . -t stillwater-sc/universal:${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Push Docker image
        run: docker push stillwater-sc/universal:${{ github.sha }}

  deprecate-release-yml:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Remove deprecated release.yml
        run: rm .github/workflows/release.yml
```
